investigation: PSI-20, ACME Burning Rate Emulator (BRE): porous-disc burner of 25 or 50 mm in a quiescent microgravity chamber
description: W0 law of docs/wsp/research/phys_bre_w0.md, section 7.1: self-extinction of a flame over a porous burner by radiation as it grows by diffusion. Time origin: ignition. Derived case inputs (burner_mass_flux, is_methane, stated_time and the renamed conditions) are written by tools/wsp/ext/law_inputs.py.

features.name: burner_diameter
features.description: diameter of the porous face (0.025 or 0.050)

features.name: burner_mass_flux
features.description: mass flow of the burner gas (fuel plus its nitrogen) at the first setpoint, per unit face area

features.name: x_o2
features.description: oxygen mole fraction of the chamber gas just before ignition

features.name: x_fuel
features.description: fuel mole fraction of the burner gas (1 for a pure fuel, 0.5 for the 50 % bottle)

features.name: stated_time
features.description: the time asked about by lasts; any admissible value for the other targets, which give it no weight

targets.name: flame_end
targets.description: the flame goes out by itself while the fuel flow is still at its first setpoint, seconds since ignition; no scheduled_stop condition (a stop comes from known_controls when one is known)

targets.name: lasts
targets.description: the flame is still burning stated_time seconds after ignition, flow unchanged

targets.name: height_at_end
targets.description: height of the flame above the burner centre in the last second before self-extinction (lane-local)
